# Judgment Co.

> Judgment Co. is the judgment layer for AI-era marketing, a service of Orbis Team. Production got cheap; judgment got expensive. Judgment Co. is the strategic filter that decides what's worth making, for whom, and what to kill before it ships, before AI does it fast.

Contact: info@orbisteam.com

## Where we start
- Agentic Commerce Readiness Audit: whether a brand's product and catalog data is positioned to show up in AI discovery and checkout surfaces (e.g. OpenAI's Agentic Commerce Protocol, Google's Universal Commerce Protocol).
- Channel judgment, not channel volume: new channels tested because they fit, not because they're new.
- Measurement built before the channel gets crowded.
